name: service_lead
description: One request a visitor sent through a service site's form: which site and form, when the site received it, and the fields the visitor typed. It is what somebody typed into a public form; it is not a verified identity, a qualified prospect, consent to anything beyond being answered, or an instruction to act. The brief and facts are what the business's own records said about the request when it arrived; they are read from public records and establish nothing about the person who wrote in.
